To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the catalytic performance of supported heteropoly acids (salts) is closely related to their acid strength, water tolerance and reactivity of heteropoly acids (salt), and their interaction with support.

the Cs salt of 12-phosphotungstic acid supported on dealuminated ultra-stable Yzeolite is a highly efficient catalyst for the synthesis of fructose acetal with high water tolerance, and its catalytic performance is superior to the supported PW catalyst and other solid acid catalysts.
the catalytic activity of the supported Cs salt of PW is higher than that of the supported PW catalyst, and that Cs salt supported on DUS Y is the most active catalyst among the catalysts studied.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of frutcone by acetalization over various supported heteropoly acid and salt catalysts.
the preparation of a series of supported PW catalysts and their catalytic behavior in fructone synthesis.
the development of a new type of highly active and stable catalysts for the synthesis of fructose.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Cs salt of 12-phosotungstic PW supported on DUSU was the most effective catalyst in the acetalization reaction.

the DUSY support is the most suitable one among all the tested supports for the immobilization of Cs_ 2. 5H_ 2.3PW, and the Cs salt of heteropoly acid (Cs_2.5H0. 5PW)is the most suitable heteropoly compound among all the tested heteropoly acids (salts).

the Cs salt of heteropoly acid catalysts supported on DUSYSiO_ 2 and SBA 15 were the most active and selective catalysts in the synthesis of 2,2,4-trimethyl-3,4-dihydro-2 H -pyran-4-one (fructone) by acetalization.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the catalytic behavior of heteropoly compound is closely related to its acid strength.

the supported heteropoly acid and its salt catalysts are very active for synthesis of fructones, and the supported heteropoly salt catalysts are more promising in the application of this type of catalysis due to their high water tolerance and good reusability.

the supported Cs salt of PW on DUSY could be a promising catalyst in this reaction, and its high catalytic performance could be attributed to its high water tolerance, strong acidity and high surface area.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a highly active and reusable catalyst can be obtained by using a suitable combination of the catalyst support and heteropoly acid salt.
the Cs salt of heteropoly anion is a promising catalyst in organic synthesis.
the Cs salt of heteropoly anion is more stable than the parent acid, and the DUSY is the best support for the Cs salt of HPA in the synthesis of 2,2,5,5-tetramethyl-3-oxo-1,3-oxathiolane.
